original_card.question: Does one changed supplier or assembly claim lack a source-bound independent check of a specific new implication?
methods: Independently reconstruct a coordinated frame/circuit change and its single-change control, then derive the complete rank and physical ledger.
Implement certified moment inequalities through a different exact enclosure method.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Demonstrate independence, source binding, positive cases and semantic failure controls. Name the existing checks and the missing coverage. More digits or another equivalent evaluation of an unchanged root is not by itself new verification coverage.

first_step.inspect: Read #2979 joint rank-7 end-frame proposal and the revision-6 evidence status. Its claimed kappa is not selected. Compare coordinated changes with the losing single-change controls and locate the complete physical ledger; an aggregate moment alone does not validate the mechanism.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Prioritize a bounded independent audit of #2979: reconstruct one joint group and its single-lowering control, check the declared frames/chronology, then trace changed children, idle widths and cleanup buffers into the complete invoice and both supplier caps. Choose one still-missing implication after checking existing audits. Stop with exact unresolved dependencies if full admission exceeds the session; do not launch a new lowering census on an unvalidated premise or substitute extra root digits for mechanism checking.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Independent pricing prevents unsupported frontier claims and can reveal genuine accounting slack.
allowed_variations: Reconstruct either a source ledger or a numeric enclosure with a different method.
scope_change_triggers: Importing the primary function and calling its output independent verification.
Promoting #2979 from merged source archive to validated supplier solely from author PASS receipts or aggregate pricing.

actual_scope: Independently reconstruct #2979 group V45 (helpers 249, 251, 265, 267 on the shared rank-7 frame E_7 intersect E_42) on both PR2942 parent words, and price every subset against the published integer frame surrogate, including the losing single-helper controls.
scope_change_reason: The card asks for one coordinated group and its losing single-change control, then the complete invoice. This package does that for V45 only. It does not rerun #2979 admission, re-derive the moment weights, or audit groups A-D, stage 2, or stage 3.
bottleneck_link: A joint frame lowering is useful only if its paid profile, freed widths and cleanup actually improve the supplier bill. Checking one group against its single-change controls separates that local saving from the unvalidated kappa claim.
stop_rule: Stop after one group, both parent words, and the subset-margin identity. Do not launch another lowering census or a full native admission if the local invoice still leaves the moment weights or supplier caps open.
evidence: verify.py recomputes both parent profiles, all 16 V45 subsets, the exact overhead identity 4*(c_1-2091300)-78512=22972, unchanged cleanup, and two nonmonotone mutants.

open_questions.question: Do groups A, B, C and D have the same exact one-rank saving per added helper, with a single shared frame overhead, on both parent words?
open_questions.why_it_matters: V45 is only one of the five groups in the #2979 stage-1 claim. The other four are not certified by this package.
open_questions.first_step: Repeat this verifier with those groups isolated by the same new-frame containment rule, without importing producer.py.
open_questions.blocked_by: Nothing mathematical blocks the same finite check. It was left out to keep this package to one group.

open_questions.question: Does the V45 local margin survive an independent enclosure of c_r and the full idle-width packing cap?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The +22972 unit margin uses #2979 published integer weights and a fixed break-even of 2091300. It is not a kappa and does not price idle children or the other supplier.
open_questions.first_step: Recompute lo_r(b) at b=0.001703676387993676 from the frame-domain-ceiling engines, then price the measured profile delta.
open_questions.blocked_by: Those engines and the T74 allocation are outside this package. Unknown cap movement is not zero.
